thread:
caroline-cs: Heads up — ACME hit a spike of 403s right after their IdP cert rotation. They say embeddings still work but generation/chat calls return \"insufficient_entitlements: generation\". Customer rolled the refresh tokens at ~2024-04-05T08:20Z and failures started immediately.

ben-eng: ugh. can you paste an example of the token response from the refresh flow (redact sub/jti)? curious what claims the IdP is sending now.

caroline-cs: pasted snippet from ACME SRE: 
```
POST https://idp.acme/oauth/token
grant_type=refresh_token&refresh_token=...
200 OK
{
  \"access_token\": \"eyJhbGci...\",
  \"expires_in\": 3600,
  \"token_type\": \"Bearer\",
  \"scope\": \"\",
  \"claims\": {\"permissions\": \"inference:generate embeddings:read rerank:invoke\"} 
}
```
(They say the provider added a custom claim `claims.permissions` during the cert rotation mapping change.)

maya-support: ACME also attached a decoded JWT snippet (redacted): 
```
{
  \"iss\": \"https://idp.acme/\",
  \"aud\": \"redwood-api\",
  \"exp\": 1712627200,
  \"iat\": 1712623600,
  \"permissions\": [\"inference:generate\",\"embeddings:read\",\"rerank:invoke\"],
  \"sub\": \"redacted\"
}
```

ben-eng: that explains it — our auth middleware currently reads `scope` (space-delimited string) and `scp` claim variants. we don't look at a `permissions` top-level claim or `claims.permissions`. so the token appears to the platform as having zero entitlements. hence 403 on generate. embeddings worked earlier because they call a routed path that falls back to a different check? (will verify).

caroline-cs: ACME says they didn't change app config, only rotated certs / re-published claim mappings from the IdP admin.

ben-eng: quick repro steps I ran locally against a test IdP that returns `permissions` array:
```bash
# exchange refresh token
curl -s -X POST https://idp.test/oauth/token \ 
  -d 'grant_type=refresh_token&refresh_token=REDACTED' \
  -H 'content-type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' | jq
# decode JWT and inspect claims
echo EY... | cut -d'.' -f2 | base64 -d | jq
```
Result: permissions present, scope empty. Redwood auth -> claims parser returns [] -> no entitlements -> 403 generation.

maya-support: customer wants a fast workaround. they can either: 1) create a long‑lived API key via Console for immediate unblocked usage, or 2) ask IdP admin to map scopes into the `scope`/`scp` claim while we push a fix. which should we recommend?

ben-eng: recommend API key for urgent unblock. engineering to add tolerant parsing for `permissions`/`claims.permissions` as an alias for `scope` so tokens from IdPs with custom mappings don't break. small change in auth-proxy.

caroline-cs: passed advice to ACME SRE. they're going to create an API key and also open a ticket with their IdP to re-map.

ben-eng: assigning to me. plan: detect `permissions` as array or space-delimited string during token introspect, merge into our entitlement set. add unit tests for array/string variants. patch will be behind a feature flag.

acme-sre: quick note from their side — their Okta admin confirmed they pushed a new claim mapping that put claims into `permissions` array instead of `scope`. they reverted mapping for the app but some users already got refreshed tokens with the new claim.

ben-eng: ok — two action items: 
- support: confirm which customer sessions need API key and send instructions (caroline)
- eng: add alias mapping and roll to staging behind flag (ben)

maya-support: Caroline — I emailed ACME console API key steps and a short FAQ on rotating keys. they confirmed API key worked and generation calls are green for the next hour.

ben-eng: pushed a small PR to auth-proxy branch that coalesces `permissions`/`claims.permissions` into the entitlement parsing. RTD: 2h for code + CI. will feature flag it.

devops-bot: deploy-bot: started deploy to staging of branch auth/alias-permissions (build #4782)

caroline-cs: customer confirmed staging tests (using a newly minted test token with `permissions`) now succeed when we hit the staging endpoint. they still plan to update their IdP mapping but appreciate the tolerant parsing. :relieved:

ben-eng: will schedule prod rollout once we have 24h of staging smoke. leaving the thread open for any regressions.

devops-bot: deploy-bot: rollout to staging completed (build #4782). monitoring 20m.

caroline-cs: closing customer ticket in Zendesk once prod rollout is done and ACME confirms IdP fix. thanks all. :tada:
